comment: Every public image CI pulls, by the digest it is pinned to everywhere else (environments/*/Dockerfile, including the embedder image's two bases, packages/verifier WEB_API_BUILD_IMAGE, tests/support/linux-dind.ts). The Mirror CI images workflow copies each one, digest for digest, to ghcr.io/<owner>/rovara-ci/<name>; CI pulls from there first (scripts/ci-images.ts). Changing a digest here without changing it where it is pinned fails tests/contract/ci-images.test.ts.
